text:
maria: Nightly perf CI flagged a regression for candidate kernel 0x3b on H100 for seq_len 512/1024 microbench. Putting notes here so we can coordinate.

ci-bot: nightly/kernel-microbench results: candidate-0x3b @ h100:
- seq_len=512: baseline(0x2a)=12.8ms -> candidate=15.2ms (+19%)
- seq_len=1024: baseline(0x2a)=25.6ms -> candidate=31.0ms (+21%)
job: https://ci.internal/redwood/nightly/1782345678 (artifact attached) :warning:

devon: Can someone try a local repro? quick command to run a focused microbench:
```
./tools/microbench --kernel=0x3b --hw=h100 --seq-len=512 --batch=1 --iters=2000 --out=mb-1782345678.log
```

maria: I ran that and captured the run summary (excerpt):
```
cmd: ./tools/microbench --kernel=0x3b --hw=h100 --seq-len=512 --batch=1 --iters=2000
avg_latency_ms: 15.18
p95_ms: 16.20
alloc_bytes: 1.2GB
kv_cache_hits: 0  # no prefix used for this run
mem_bandwidth_gbs: 420
kv_evictions: 0
```

aisha: Interesting — with the same kernel on A100 the regression is much smaller (~5%). This smells like a sequence-length dependent memory access pattern that interacts badly with H100 L2. Also, when we add a prefix (kv-cache warm) the latency delta grows.

kevin: Proposal: expand microbench matrix in the harness to exercise prefix-heavy workloads + multiple batch sizes. We should run the cross product: seq_len {256,512,1024}, batch {1,4,8}, kv_prefix {0,1024,2048}, hw {a100,h100}. Add a prefetch toggle too (--enable-prefetch).

devon: Also run the profiler (nsight/cupti) to collect L2/shared mem stalls. Quick profile command I use:
```
./tools/profile --kernel=0x3b --hw=h100 --seq-len=512 --batch=1 --iters=2000 --out=prof-1782345678
# produces prof-1782345678.nsys and counters.txt
```
I saw L2 load miss ratio ~2x vs 0x2a on a failing run.

aisha: Can we also log kv_evictions and per-token memcpy counts in the microbench output? Those helped in past regressions.

maria: I'll add a temporary autotune policy tweak: if H100 && seq_len >= 512 then fallback to 0x2a until we root cause. Not ideal but keeps prod stable.

runtime-bot: Autotuner: candidate 0x3b currently preferred for seq_len >= 256 on our perf-train set. Flagging candidate-0x3b as "investigate/h100-flaky" until CI confirms fix.

aisha: I'll open a PR to expand the nightly harness and include the extra counters. PR #8421 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8421. Changes: add kv_prefix matrix, batch sizes, enable-prefetch flag, and kv_evictions + mem_bandwidth counters to JSON artifacts.

ci-bot: queued job: nightly-microbench-sweep-coverage (matrix size 48). est run time ~2h. Will post results back in this thread.

kevin: Another thought — kernel 0x3b relies on a software prefetch heuristic we recently tweaked for AArch64; that heuristic may not be optimal for H100's prefetcher. Add --enable-prefetch=true/false to the matrix.

maria: Good call. If the prefetched runs recover perf then we have a clear mitigation. I'll also backfill the last 7 nightly artifacts to see when 0x3b diverged.

devon: Logging note for the harness: include the exact kernel dispatch path string (e.g., "kpick: fused-attn-vec4-lane-prefetch") and the kernel build tag/hash so we can correlate with autotune DB.

aisha: PR #8421 includes the dispatch path string and kernel hash in the microbench JSON. I also added a small unit that asserts each matrix cell finishes in <1.5x baseline before marking job flaky.

maria: I'll land the fallback autotune entry if nightly shows >10% regressions for H100. Filing tracking issue now and linking ci artifacts. cc @aisha @devon @kevin

ci-bot: nightly-microbench-sweep-coverage started: https://ci.internal/redwood/nightly/1782345800 (watching for results).

kevin: If anyone wants to run a quick differential with a warm kv-cache try:
```
./tools/microbench --kernel=0x3b --hw=h100 --seq-len=512 --batch=4 --kv-prefix=2048 --iters=1000
```
That run tends to blow up the mem bandwidth.

maria: Thanks everyone. Action items: a) aisha to land harness expansion (PR #8421) b) devon to run profiler and attach counters c) kevin to test prefetch toggle d) I'll update autotune DB fallback if nightly confirms.

aisha: :thumbsup:

maria: cheers, will update thread with CI artifacts and tracking issue link.
